plan.title: bug(design-critique): ensureArcDest via stale gitignored packages/core/dist skips guarded-prep, so arc dests launch without runtime

narratives.Description: bug(design-critique): ensureArcDest via stale gitignored packages/core/dist skips guarded-prep, so arc dests launch without runtime
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Agents that call `ensureArcDest` via `require(packages/core/dist/design-critique/arc-dest.js)` against a **gitignored stale local dist** get `ok: true` without running default `installMode: guarded-prep` (#6100 source). Arc dests then lack `node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime`, and host hooks block `gh` / other verbs in that cwd. Silent incomplete prep is the failure mode.

## Evidence (dogfood arc #6136)

1. Source at tip (`packages/core/src/design-critique/arc-dest.ts`) defaults `installMode` to `guarded-prep` and calls `prepareLinkedWorktree`.
2. `packages/*/dist/` is gitignored. Local dist on this host was weeks stale and had **no** `installMode` / `prepareLinkedWorktree`.
3. `ensureArcDest({ repoRoot, destPath: '.deft-scratch/worktrees/arc-6136' })` returned `ok` / `reused: false` after bare `git worktree add --detach` only.
4. Dest had `package.json`, no `node_modules`, no runtime pin. Dest-rooted Grok Round-1 critic hung: hooks refused `gh` ("runtime package is missing").
5. Recovery: operator-authorized kill; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false` in the dest; rebuild primary `packages/core` dist restored guarded-prep.

## Expected Prefer-A shape (thin)

One fail-closed path so arc dest create cannot silently skip guarded-prep:

1. Ship a pin-bin verb (e.g. `deft design-critique:ensure-arc-dest`) that always runs current guarded-prep (or explicit `process-only-no-install`), **or**
2. Skill/contract MUST: never `require(packages/core/dist/...)` for `ensureArcDest` on framework-source without a fresh build / pin path; refuse or warn when dist lacks `installMode`.

Optional: dest readiness probe before critic spawn (`worktreeHasRuntimePin` / outer-visible pin) fail-closed with remediation.

## Non-goals / keep-outs

- #5892 — primary checkout pin/install drift blocking read-only parent session (different location).
- #5882 — `swarm:finalize-cohort` lifecycle checkout skips package install.
- #5836 — SEC-WT junction realpath into primary `.pnpm`.
- Closed #6100 — Codex hook-root / linked-worktree bootstrap Prefer-A (source already has guarded-prep; this issue is the **invocation/stale-dist** hole).

## Acceptance

1. Creating an arc dest via the sanctioned path runs guarded-prep (or records explicit `process-only-no-install`) and cannot return success with missing runtime pin when guarded-prep was selected.
2. Docs/skill name the sanctioned invocation (verb or rebuild/pin rule).
3. Dogfood: fresh `arc-<N>` dest can post `gh issue comment` without manual `pnpm install` when using the sanctioned path.

Refs #6136 (dogfood), #6100, #5892, #5882

Filed for @MScottAdams

## Plain-language summary
Source `ensureArcDest` already defaults to guarded-prep, but agents that load a gitignored stale `packages/core/dist` copy get a silent ok without install. Prefer-A is one sanctioned pin-bin (or skill-MUST) path that cannot succeed with a missing runtime pin when guarded-prep was selected.

## Findings

### blocks-the-design: gitignored dist is not the source contract
- Evidence: tip source `arc-dest.ts` defaults `installMode` to `guarded-prep` and calls `prepareLinkedWorktree`. `.gitignore` has `packages/*/dist/`. Dogfood #6136: stale dist returned ok after bare worktree add; dest lacked `@deftai/directive-runtime`; hooks blocked `gh`.
- Failure mode: agents treat `require(packages/core/dist/...)` as current API; silent incomplete prep.
- Disposition: Prefer-A must remove that silent path (verb and/or fail-closed readiness).

### blocks-the-design: no pin-bin ensure-arc-dest verb
- Evidence: Stop 1 Expected Prefer-A names `deft design-critique:ensure-arc-dest`; CLI registry/search on tip shows spend-resolve family but no ensure-arc-dest verb; skill points at library `ensureArcDest`.
- Failure mode: every framework-source arc rediscovers `require(dist)` or ad-hoc `git worktree add`.
- Disposition: Bound limb — ship pin-bin verb that always runs current guarded-prep (or explicit `process-only-no-install`).

### sharpens-framing: readiness probe before critic spawn
- Evidence: `worktreeHasRuntimePin` / outer-visible pin already exist in `worktree-pm-install.ts`; critic launch after ensure still posted with missing pin in #6136 dogfood.
- Failure mode: ensure ok + missing pin → hung critic.
- Disposition: optional Bound limb — fail-closed readiness before Round-1 spawn when mode is guarded-prep.

### footnote: keep-outs stay out
- #5892 primary pin-drift; #5882 finalize-cohort skip-install; #5836 SEC-WT junction; closed #6100 source Prefer-A already landed guarded-prep.

## Bound remedy
- Pin-bin `design-critique:ensure-arc-dest` (guarded-prep default; explicit `process-only-no-install`) — relieves: P1, P3
- Fail closed when guarded-prep selected and runtime pin still missing after prep — relieves: P2
- Skill/contract MUST: sanctioned verb (or rebuild+pin path); never treat gitignored dist as SoT — relieves: P3
